benefits.text:
BBIA Nudy Slim Eyeliner is an ultra-slim gel eyeliner that helps create natural lines in a “nude shading” style — soft like eyeshadow yet precise like eyeliner. It helps keep the natural structure of the eyes, creating a look of depth that is refined and not as harsh as traditional black/brown eyeliner.

Design highlights:
- Ultra-slim 1.5mm tip, easy to apply close to the lash line, waterline, lower lid and eye corners.
- Convenient twist-up pencil design, suited to creating slim, detailed and natural lines.
- Easy to control on small areas around the eyes, especially the under-eye, inner corner and outer corner.

Texture highlights:
- Soft gel cream texture that glides on smoothly and adheres smoothly to the skin.
- Semi-transparent, low-saturation color payoff that helps the line blend more naturally into eye makeup.
- Can be lightly blended after lining to create a soft shading effect like eyeshadow.
- Natural finish that is not too intense, suited to clean eyes, soft nude eyes and natural shading makeup styles.

Formula highlights:
- Waterproof & smudge-proof formula that helps minimize smudging and wearing off throughout the day.
- Good adherence while keeping a soft feel, so the line does not look too stiff.
- Suitable for many areas around the eyes, such as the lash line, waterline, inner corner, outer corner and under-eye.

Shade range highlights:
- 9 nude shading shades in low-saturation tones that blend easily with the skin and are easy to pair with makeup.
- The shade range is divided by need: natural lining, opening up the eye corners, accenting the eye corners, waterline and under-eye.
- Neutral, soft brown, mauve, rose, peach and ivory tones help add subtle depth to the eyes without making makeup look heavy.

Certifications & testing:
- Vegan certified.
- Skin irritation test completed.

howToUse.text: Before use, lightly apply setting powder or eyeshadow to reduce oil and moisture around the eyes. Twist up about 1–2mm of the core each time and line lightly along the lash line, waterline, eye corners or under-eye area. You can lightly blend right after lining to create a soft shading effect. On first use, twist slowly until the core appears.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.
